provenance.status: Analytical estimates; no hardware or trained-model validation performed.
provenance.model: Feature-Map Radio Budget Version 2 (2026-10-16); results_v1.json holds the v1 model.
corrections: Exclude task-incompatible final SleepFM temporal pooling.
Include MCU sleep energy during DMA-mode transmission.
Count AttX raw input on the full 10-s window, consistent with its feature cuts.
Charge BLE connection maintenance and Wi-R sleep during computation as well as idle time.
v2: 11-B packet overhead at LE 2M; no trailing inter-frame space; last connection event charged for its actual packets.
v2: transfer time to the last packet instead of whole connection intervals; reserved intervals must fit the period.
v2: no separate radio sleep current for MCUs with a built-in BLE radio.
v2: Wi-R losses recovered by blind copies chosen for a whole-map delivery target.

presets.src: ST DS13195: 120 µA/MHz Run, SMPS, 3.3 V, 25 °C (…Q part). SRAM = 1 MB AXI block (1.4 MB total).

presets.name: STM32U585
presets.mpcSrc: measured on STM32U575 (same core): MLPerf Tiny v1.3, X-CUBE-AI 10.2
presets.src: ST DS13086: 19.5 µA/MHz @ 3.3 V (feature page; regulator not confirmed). MLPerf energy measured at 1.8 V.

presets.name: STM32U385
presets.src: ST datasheet: 16 µA/MHz CoreMark, SMPS, 96 MHz, 3.3 V. MLPerf energy measured at 1.8 V.

presets.name: STM32L4R5 (L4+)
presets.src: ST DS12023: 43 µA/MHz with SMPS variant (110 µA/MHz LDO). MLPerf energy at 3 V.

presets.name: STM32L476
presets.src: ST DS10198: 100 µA/MHz Run, LDO (no SMPS on this part).

presets.name: STM32WBA52 (BLE)
presets.src: ST DS14127: 23 µA/MHz Run @ 3.3 V (feature page). Built-in BLE 5.4: TX 5.2 mA / RX 4.4 mA.

presets.name: nRF52840 (BLE)
presets.src: Nordic PS: 52 µA/MHz CoreMark from flash, DC/DC 3 V.

presets.name: nRF5340 app core (BLE)

presets.src: Nordic PS: 66 CoreMark/mA at 128 MHz → ≈60.8 µA/MHz (calculated), DC/DC 3 V.

presets.name: nRF54L15 (BLE)
presets.src: Nordic Developer Academy: 20 µA/MHz CoreMark from NVM @128 MHz, 3 V (not the datasheet table).

presets.name: Ambiq Apollo3 Blue (BLE)
presets.src: Ambiq DS-A3 Table 1203: 10.3 µA/MHz CoreMark @48 MHz, 3.3 V, buck (6 µA/MHz is the while-loop figure).

presets.name: Ambiq Apollo4 Blue Plus (BLE)
presets.src: Ambiq datasheet Table 34: 15.4–17.2 µA/MHz CoreMark @96 MHz, 1.9 V, buck.

presets.name: Ambiq Apollo510
presets.src: Ambiq DS-A510 Table 39: 46.8 µW/MHz CoreMark @250 MHz, 1.8 V (≈26 µA/MHz).

presets.name: SiLabs EFR32MG24 / BG24 (BLE, MVP)
presets.mpcSrc: measured: MLPerf Tiny v1.0, TFLM + MVP accelerator
presets.src: SiLabs datasheet Table 4.5: 49.1 µA/MHz CoreMark @78 MHz, 3.0 V, DC-DC. MLPerf energy at 1.8 V.

presets.name: SiLabs EFR32BG22 (BLE)
presets.src: SiLabs datasheet Table 4.5: 37 µA/MHz CoreMark @76.8 MHz, 3.0 V, DC-DC. Only 32 KB SRAM.

presets.name: TI CC2340R5 (BLE)
presets.src: TI SWRS272F §7.9: 53 µA/MHz CoreMark @48 MHz, 3.0 V, DC/DC.

presets.name: TI CC2652R (BLE)
presets.src: TI SWRS207J §8.5: 3.39 mA CoreMark @48 MHz, 3.0 V, DC/DC (71 µA/MHz).

presets.sleepSrc: Software Standby with all SRAM ≈0.9 mA
presets.name: Renesas RA8M1
presets.mpcSrc: measured on RA8D1 (same M85 core): MLPerf Tiny v1.2, TFLM + CMSIS
presets.src: Renesas RA8M1 datasheet Table 2.19: 318 µA/MHz CoreMark, IDD (core supply) @480 MHz.

presets.name: NXP MCX N947 (CPU only)
presets.src: NXP datasheet Table 20: 9.19 mA while(1) @150 MHz, DCDC 3.3 V (≈57 µA/MHz). Its eIQ Neutron NPU is not modelled here.

presets.name: Alif Balletto B1 (BLE, CPU only)
presets.src: Alif product page: 22 µA/MHz @ 3.3 V (workload not stated). Its Ethos-U55 NPU is not modelled here.
